rule.title: Deterministic Dependency Pinning and Vulnerability Auditing
rule.statement: Package dependencies must be strictly committed with lockfiles (package-lock.json). CI must execute npm audit / security vulnerability scans on every build.
rule.rationale: Unpinned or loose dependency ranges (^1.2.0) allow upstream compromises or breaking sub-dependency releases to break production builds unexpectedly.
rule.implementation_guidance: Use npm ci in CI pipelines. Run npm audit --audit-level=high in quality gates.

forbidden.example: npm install with wildcards (*) and omitting package-lock.json from version control.

preferred.example: npm ci (strictly installing exact versions verified by package-lock.json).

source.evidence_quote: Dependencies represent an ongoing commitment and risk. Pin exact dependency versions and automate security audits to protect against supply chain vulnerabilities.
